The '''Oroboro Killik Caverns''' was inhabited by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of the [[Oroboro]] hive and located in the [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], [[Vector Hyllus]] resided inside the caverns.
